title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：steak　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 steak 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the cook ① cooked the steak that no guest in the canteen would have described, and he said the cooking was the whole of the day. The ② steak, meaning the meat itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; a steak, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ steak in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ steak at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A steak, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the cook said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the steak was the whole of the matter, meaning the treat and not the meat. The ⑥ steak, meaning the treat and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; steak, he said, is either something you cook or the only word that means both a meat and a treat. He said the treat is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ steak had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ steak of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of describing; steak, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ steak I remember is the meat described in the menu, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the canteen. A ⑩ steak, my mother said in 1991, is the only meat that improves by being described; every steak, she said, is a treat that has agreed to look like a meat. She said the treat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 牛排（指食堂里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 牛排（指那块牛排本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：cook the steak 煎这一块牛排
D. n. 牛排（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 牛排之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的牛排之事）
F. n. 牛排（指菜单里写到、被描述的那一块）
G. n. 牛排、款待（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 款待（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cooked the steak that no guest in the canteen would have described
The steak, meaning the meat itself and not the bowl
the steak at the far table
the steak was the whole of the matter
the steak had become a line in a menu
The steak of the whole thing
A steak, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: cook the steak 意为“煎这一块牛排”，1982 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯描述的一块牛排做了一遍。
steak 意为“牛排”，指那块牛排本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。
steak 意为“牛排”，指食堂里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
steak 意为“牛排”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
steak 意为“牛排、款待”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块款待就是那件事的全部。
steak 意为“款待”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块牛排，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
steak 意为“牛排”，指菜单里写到、被描述的那一块，到 1987 年这一块成了菜单里的一行。
steak 意为“牛排之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的牛排之事是一处食堂和三个日子的描述。
steak 意为“牛排”，我记得的是菜单里描述过的那一块，1989 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一块。
steak 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，牛排是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的牛排。
